label: Paper Notebook
description: Original deterministic notebook family for reasoning, study notes, derivations, and truthful review checklists using a raster-free paper field and explicit ink hierarchy.
avoidFor: asset-led product reveals where media is the subject
metric-heavy monitoring scenes requiring dashboard comparison
cinematic hooks that need full-bleed imagery

renderCost.notes: Paper grain, ruled lines, ink marks, checks, and annotations are deterministic CSS and DOM primitives with no media decode cost.

reducedMotion.notes: Reduced mode shortens travel to a small reveal, while static mode presents the complete notebook hierarchy without animation.

accessibility.notes: Dark navy ink on warm paper, semantic red used sparingly, stable baselines, and fixed annotation width preserve portrait readability.

directorCompatibility.selectionReason: Choose when the narration exposes working logic, study notes, a compact derivation, or a review checklist whose annotations matter.
hardBlocks: requires more than five checklist items

sourcePolicy.notes: The package uses original Lucida fixture copy and renderer geometry. It contains no raster paper, logos, screenshots, font binaries, or copied brand identity.

knownLimitations: Shared registry and app-root availability remain untouched because they are outside this ownership slice.
16:9 support is metadata-ready only; this task renders portrait review frames only.
Stable promotion requires human visual approval.
